defects.title: Plan result charts carry no recorded chart preset: they cannot be saved as evidence and offer no variant
defects.observed: results[].preset null for Q1-heatmap stats.correlation_matrix (heatmap_annotated), Q2-pancreas stats.mann_whitney_u (box_plot), Q3-clusters stats.kruskal_wallis (box_plot), Q3-clusters stats.dunn_posthoc (box_plot), Q4-partial stats.partial_correlation (scatter); chart evidence needs a presetId, so no chart could be saved

defects.suspectedLocation: axiome-back SAP child runs are compiled through the opening templates without minting a chart preset (sap/runs → governed execution); result-page/result-page-chart.ts reads preset only when one was recorded
